name: smwmusic-pok-mon-trading-card-game-club-master-duel-re-arranged
title: Pokémon Trading Card Game - Club Master Duel (re-arranged)
description:
A happy-go-lucky, challenge, epic song that has the power to cheer he who listens to it, up. To me it sounds like it could fit a broad range of levels but especially grassland, sky and industrial.

Arrangement courtesy of Musescore user Ceascer Olivian Hallenkord... Which I really want to thank since this game's OST is not among the most covered. This said I needed to change many things to this orchestral arrangement to make it more loyal to the source.

I've had lots of fun manipulating GAIN on this song.
